node: Midstream compression, flow control, and LNG-adjacent equipment
summary: Layer 1B expands the direct public-company universe around midstream compression, flow-control, and LNG-adjacent equipment. The most relevant names are not commodity producers but asset owners and equipment/service platforms whose revenue is tied to gas gathering, processing, transportation, LNG, and installed-base maintenance. The underfollowed lane is strongest in contract compression providers such as Archrock and Kodiak Gas Services, where recurring service economics and fleet utilization can act as hidden signals for midstream demand. Chart Industries and Flowserve provide broader LNG/cryogenic and flow-control context, but they are more visible and less pure in different ways.
